title: Total-complex comparison for normalized native ringed tensors
statement: Given the underived normalized comparison U and a specified scalar sign on ringed morphisms, there is a record containing the total-complex isomorphism from b.native applied to T's total to the ringed coefficient total with the reversed factors, its signed homogeneous summand equation, and its naturality under arbitrary maps of complexes.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Apply the homological-complex bifunctor comparison to U. Preservation of the diagonal coproducts makes every component an isomorphism.

proof.text: The coproduct formula gives the signed summand equation, and the naturality theorem for mapBifunctorComparison gives naturality in both complex variables.
